narrative_purpose: The chapter's representative plate on the landing book-map: the same patch of night forest holding two beings who do not share a world — a Na'vi reading a biosphere alive with signal, a human sealed in a far narrower slice of it. One image that says 'perception is a private world.'
subject: A Na'vi crouched low on a glowing forest floor at night, one hand resting on moss that answers in a spreading ring of cyan light, her luminous freckles faintly lit, her posture that of someone reading the ground; a few paces behind her the dark angular silhouette of a grounded human aircraft canopy, a small dim figure inside it lit only by a few failing red instrument glows, oblivious to the light around it.
scene: Pandoran understorey at night, glowing flora receding into teal haze, the canopy closing overhead so all light comes from living things and from the faint instrument glow of the machine.
camera: A low three-quarter view across the forest floor, the Na'vi as near focal subject, the cockpit set deeper and smaller in the mid-ground.
light: Bioluminescent key from the moss-ring and flora, lighting the Na'vi from below and ahead; a separate small pocket of cold red artificial light isolating the human in the dark — two light worlds in one frame.
palette: Void-indigo base, Pandora cyan and living teal dominant in the glow, the human cockpit a scarce muted amber-red island so the two perceptual worlds read as different temperatures of light.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted texture, observed-from-life confidence.
detail_level: Crisp on the Na'vi and the lit ground ring; the cockpit and far forest dissolving into haze.
composition: Na'vi low and forward off-centre, the cockpit deeper and opposite, generous dark negative space between them so the gap between two worlds is felt.
exclude: modern Earth objects beyond the single dark aircraft canopy
consistency_notes: Na'vi anatomy and bioluminescent freckles consistent with the book's other Na'vi; cool Pandora palette with from-within bioluminescent key. The establishing 'two worlds, one forest' mood that anchors the whole chapter.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style
